title: A queued conveyor finds another passage
description: Four ceramic packets approach a narrow neck, wait, and travel through a separately opened U-shaped bypass.
use: Logistics bottlenecks, work queues and alternate network paths.
copy: Name the constraint with native copy while packets wait. Explain the alternate route after its gate opens. Keep rates, quantities and measured delay in native graphics.
metaphor: Deterministic qualitative routing, not simulated throughput, congestion or transit time. Token count, speed and route dimensions encode no evidence.
